In [clinicbench/truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L130-L134), `clinicbench.truth._booking` sets `selfpay_max = cost - rng.choice([0, 50, 100, 200])` for `basis == "self_pay"`, which makes `selfpay_max < cost` in 75% of `selfpay_booking` truths (unlike `double_booking`, which adds `+ 100`, and `selfpay_retraction`, which explicitly overrides `selfpay_max` below cost). Consequently, when the clinician states the price, [PatientPolicy.respond](file:///work/clinicbench/policy.py#L410-L424) sees `selfpay_max < cost`, emits `too_much`, and flips `selfpay_willing` to `"no"`, causing the patient to refuse the booking.
